body: The Weeknd previewed a brand new song called “Hong Kong” in Hong Kong last night He gave fans their first listen during night 1 of his four-show run at Kai Tak Stadium. The unreleased track samples Faye Wong’s “季候風,” bringing a local music connection to the stadium performance. Y’all need him to drop this?
